name: BLE-01 discover 自动扫描轮次 → 扫描页连接登记 → 卡片在线可点 → 整体开关

setup.code: if (!globalThis.__bleMock) throw new Error('ble-mock 未注入'); return globalThis.__bleMock.getState();

steps.code: const deadline = Date.now() + 8000; for (;;) { const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; if (!p || p.route !== 'pages/scan/scan') throw new Error('当前不在 scan 页：route=' + (p && p.route)); const hit = (p.data.discovered || []).find((d) => d && (d.name === 'ML-8DCC' || d.deviceId === 'CC:8D:A2:C2:56:62')); if (hit) return { deviceId: hit.deviceId, name: hit.name }; if (Date.now() >= deadline) throw new Error('扫描结果无 ML-8DCC：discovered=' + JSON.stringify(p.data.discovered || []) + ' scanning=' + p.data.scanning + ' error=' + (p.data.error || '')); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); }

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const hit = (p.data.discovered || []).find((d) => d && d.name === 'ML-8DCC'); if (!hit) throw new Error('扫描结果丢失，无法连接：discovered=' + JSON.stringify(p.data.discovered || [])); return await p.onTapDevice({ currentTarget: { dataset: { deviceId: hit.deviceId, name: hit.name } } });

const deadline = Date.now() + 8000; for (;;) { const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const d = p && p.route === 'pages/discover/discover' ? (p.data.devices || []).find((x) => x && x.name === 'ML-8DCC') : null; if (d && d.online) { const st = globalThis.__bleMock.getState(); if (st.scanCount < 2) throw new Error('返回列表未自动重扫（轮次扫描）：scanCount=' + st.scanCount); if (p.data.scanError) throw new Error('discover 重扫报错：' + p.data.scanError); return { deviceId: d.deviceId, name: d.name, online: d.online, scanCount: st.scanCount }; } if (Date.now() >= deadline) throw new Error('discover 卡片未点亮：route=' + ((pages[pages.length - 1] || {}).route) + ' devices=' + JSON.stringify(((pages[pages.length - 1] || {}).data || {}).devices || []) + ' scanError=' + (((pages[pages.length - 1] || {}).data || {}).scanError || '')); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); }

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const d = (p.data.devices || []).find((x) => x && x.name === 'ML-8DCC'); if (!d) throw new Error('设备卡缺失：devices=' + JSON.stringify(p.data.devices || [])); if (!d.online) throw new Error('设备卡为灰卡，不可点：deviceId=' + d.deviceId); return p.onTapCard({ currentTarget: { dataset: { name: d.name, deviceId: d.deviceId || '' } } });

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; if (p.route !== 'pages/device/device') throw new Error('未进入设备页：route=' + p.route); if (p.data.connected !== true) throw new Error('设备页未连接：data=' + JSON.stringify({ connected: p.data.connected, reconnecting: p.data.reconnecting, transferMessage: p.data.transferMessage, errorMessage: p.data.errorMessage, name: p.data.name })); if (!p.__probe) { p.__probe = []; const origToggle = p.onTogglePower.bind(p); p.onTogglePower = function (e) { p.__probe.push({ call: 'onTogglePower', detail: e && e.detail, powerOn: p.data.powerOn, dcBusy: p._dcBusy, ts: Date.now() }); return origToggle(e); }; const origSet = p.setData.bind(p); p.setData = function (patch, cb) { try { if (patch && typeof patch === 'object' && 'powerOn' in patch) p.__probe.push({ call: 'setData', powerOn: patch.powerOn, ts: Date.now() }); } catch (err) {} return origSet(patch, cb); }; } return { connected: p.data.connected, powerOn: p.data.powerOn, readOnly: p.data.readOnly };

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; if (p.data.powerOn !== false) throw new Error('关开关未生效：powerOn=' + p.data.powerOn + ' transferMessage=' + (p.data.transferMessage || '')); return { powerOn: p.data.powerOn, transferMessage: p.data.transferMessage || '' };

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const deadline = Date.now() + 6000; for (;;) { if (p._dcBusy !== true) return { settled: true, powerOn: p.data.powerOn }; if (Date.now() >= deadline) throw new Error('关灯命令 6 s 未结算：_dcBusy 仍为 true，powerOn=' + p.data.powerOn + ' transferMessage=' + (p.data.transferMessage || '')); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); }

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; if (p._dcBusy === true) throw new Error('关灯命令仍在途，先等结算'); const r = await p.onTogglePower({ detail: { value: true }, currentTarget: {}, target: {} }); return { powerOn: p.data.powerOn, transferMessage: p.data.transferMessage || '' };

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; if (p.data.powerOn !== true) throw new Error('开开关未生效：powerOn=' + p.data.powerOn + ' transferMessage=' + (p.data.transferMessage || '') + ' probe=' + JSON.stringify(p.__probe || [])); if (p.data.transferMessage) throw new Error('开开关 ACK 失败回滚/报错：powerOn=' + p.data.powerOn + ' transferMessage=' + p.data.transferMessage + ' probe=' + JSON.stringify(p.__probe || [])); return { powerOn: p.data.powerOn, transferMessage: p.data.transferMessage || '' };

assertions.code: const ps = getCurrentPages(); const d = ps.find((x) => x && x.route === 'pages/discover/discover'); const card = d ? (d.data.devices || []).find((x) => x && x.name === 'ML-8DCC') : null; return { online: !!(card && card.online), scanError: (d && d.data.scanError) || '' };
